[Trend Position]
· Current price (268,500 KRW) vs SMA5 (272,200 KRW)/SMA20 (267,075 KRW)/SMA50 (256,830 KRW): below short-term, above mid-term, indicating mid-term strength.
· Position relative to SMA100 (280,903 KRW)/SMA200 (227,978 KRW): suggesting potential shift to weaker mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (62.8%) + current price range in historical neutral territory.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (54.4→51.2) + neutral range consolidation + lack of directional momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (1893.5358→410.1211) + improving signal + trend reversal unconfirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band 267,075 KRW) + band width at 14.55% level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (246,000 KRW) + based on Pivot S1 (247,833 KRW).
· Swing resistance (279,000 KRW) + potential for upward reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (consolidation) + trend interpretation inconclusive.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.24x) + moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + wait-and-see conditions maintained.
